justified_rtl_changes: Initial implementation uses a rising-edge D register with active-high synchronous reset taking priority over d. No RTL revisions.
justified_tb_changes: Initial independent testbench checks both data values, reset priority, repeated reset, release, and stability during high/low phases and falling edges. No testbench revisions.
interface_cycle_contract: TopModule(clk, d, r, q), all one bit; q captures d on each rising edge unless r is high, when q becomes zero.
numeric_width_decisions: All ports and stored state are one bit.
pipeline_latency_and_ii: Single rising-edge capture; accepts a new value every rising edge.
static_review: One always_ff driver, nonblocking assignments, exact required ports and synchronous reset.
